decisions.reason: Adding one spare INA3221 monitor channel does not change the DCDC1 voltage, current rating, or power-source role.
Monitoring the 5V rail and retaining a spare monitor channel do not change the boost converter, enable control, loads, or standby policy.
The spare current-monitor channel does not alter the AXP2101 battery input or system power path.
Rail-current monitor channel allocation is independent of battery NTC thermal monitoring.
The source decision does not resolve or change the battery connector family, pin count, functions, part number, or pin-order ambiguity.
The available current-monitor channel does not change battery cutoff thresholds, protection circuitry, or protection functions.
The source decision concerns rail-current measurement capacity and does not change the battery-charge status display or LED interface.
The candidate already identifies INA3221 among the powered loads, and one spare monitor channel does not change the standalone USB supply behavior.
Measuring the 5V rail does not change LED supply voltage, data-level shifting, GPIO routing, or standby power control.
The source confirms monitor-channel capacity but does not change interboard connectors, pin assignments, rail forwarding, or the board power chain.
The spare current-monitor channel has no effect on the selected ESP32-S3 module or part number.
The source decision does not change USB enumeration, programming-port behavior, connector sourceability, or USB data routing.
